name: Kukkyou na koufu ya senshi ga daraku shiteiku
original_name: 屈強な鉱夫や戦士が堕落していく
source:
In a quiet mining town, Craig and his son Wilson live a modest but peaceful life. That changes when Osmond, a wealthy alchemist, arrives and hires the miners to extract a strange white mineral hidden deep within the mountain—an area long forbidden. Unbeknownst to them, the mountain is no ordinary rock but a shell, holding a slumbering demon named Priapus at its core.

When a sudden explosion traps the miners underground, chaos erupts. With no one else willing to take the risk, Craig ventures alone into the collapsing tunnels. His mission: rescue the trapped miners and uncover the terrifying secret buried beneath the mountain.

From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/mighty-mine-1-137724568]Patreon[/url]
translation:
在一个安静的矿业小镇，克雷格和他的儿子威尔逊过着简朴但平静的生活。当富有的炼金术士奥斯蒙德到来并雇佣矿工开采隐藏在山深处的一种奇怪的白色矿物时，情况发生了变化——这是一个长期被禁止的区域。他们不知道的是，这座山并不是普通的岩石，而是一个外壳，其核心藏着一个沉睡的名叫普里阿普斯的恶魔。

当突然的爆炸将矿工困在地下时，混乱爆发了。由于没有其他人愿意冒险，克雷格独自冒险进入崩塌的隧道。他的任务是：营救被困矿工并揭开埋藏在山下的可怕秘密。

来自 [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/mighty-mine-1-137724568]Patreon[/url]
